subject: Backfill request: IC->Lead promotion and headcount tradeoffs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Backfill request: IC->Lead promotion and headcount tradeoffs

Team —

Quick ask: I’d like to request a freeze-exception to backfill the IC seat on the data infra team that will open if we promote Priya N. to Senior Lead (IC->Lead transition). This is a promotion based on the recent performance review cycle — Priya exceeded expectations across roadmap delivery, took on cross-team ownership for the KV-cache rollout, and has strong feedback from product and infra partners.

Why an exception: the FY26 hiring freeze is active, but this is a promotion-driven vacancy that we believe is net-neutral for headcount if we move an unallocated QE hire from Q1 into a later slot. The tradeoffs:
- Net headcount delta: 0 (promote internally + shift an open req to H2).
- Near-term ramp risk: low — we have an internal candidate for the IC backfill (engineering IC interested), can start onboarding week of 12/8.
- Cost impact: +$8k annual run-rate for promotion salary adjustment, offset by delaying a planned external hire (~$130k) to H2; see attached spreadsheet for FY26 delta and hiring plan.

Ask: approve an exception for 1 headcount backfill tied to the promotion (Priya -> Senior Lead). If approved, I’ll:
1) route official promotion packet to HR and comp;
2) freeze the external QE req and reassign the spend to cover the promotion delta;
3) start backfill interview loop with internal candidate next week.

Attachments: backfill_justification_20251103.pdf, hc_cost_delta_spreadsheet_20251103.xlsx

Appreciate quick confirmation so we can include this in the org changes before compensation run.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Data Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Backfill request: IC->Lead promotion and headcount tradeoffs

Marissa —

Thanks for the write-up. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) Can you confirm the exact comp band movement for Priya (base + bonus expectation)? I need the numbers to reconcile with finance.
2) Which specific req ID are you proposing to delay? We need to ensure we don’t create a downstream capacity gap on Platform reliability.
3) If we delay the external hire, what is the contingency if the internal backfill doesn’t accept?

Please include HR in the thread for policy — cc’ing Lauren is fine but also loop in people ops if you need an official freeze exception.

If you can get me the spreadsheet numbers this morning I’ll try to review before the 10:00 ops sync.

—Markus
VP, Engineering

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: peopleops-hr@peopleops.example.com
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Backfill request: IC->Lead promotion and headcount tradeoffs

On Tue, Nov 4, 2025 at 08:20 AM Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa —
>
> Thanks for the write-up. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
> 1) Can you confirm the exact comp band movement for Priya (base + bonus expectation)? I need the numbers to reconcile with finance.
> 2) Which specific req ID are you proposing to delay? We need to ensure we don’t create a downstream capacity gap on Platform reliability.
> 3) If we delay the external hire, what is the contingency if the internal backfill doesn’t accept?

Answers below and attaching updated spreadsheet with line-level numbers: hc_cost_delta_spreadsheet_20251103.xlsx

1) Comp move: base +6.5% (~$7,200/year), target bonus moves from 10% -> 12% (~$1,000 expected uplift). Total comp uplift ~ $8,200 ARR. The attachment includes comp bands and finance code for the promotion transaction.
2) Req to delay: REQ-PLAT-2347 (open QE role in Platform reliability, originally planned for Q1 FY26). I’ve discussed with Platform EM (informal) and they confirm temporary coverage plan using a contractor bench for 8–10 weeks if needed.
3) Contingency: internal candidate (Samir K.) has expressed interest and is at manager interview stage with Eng Directors; if he declines, we will: a) extend contractor for up to 10 weeks, b) pull a delivery-focused engineer from a low-priority project for 4–6 weeks while we reopen an external search with acceleration budget.

Attachments: backfill_justification_20251103.pdf, hc_cost_delta_spreadsheet_20251103.xlsx

Tagging peopleops-hr for the formal freeze-exception form and comp approval timeline.

—Marissa
Director, Data Infrastructure

From: PeopleOps HR <peopleops-hr@peopleops.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Backfill request: IC->Lead promotion and headcount tradeoffs

Hi Marissa / Team —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. We can process a freeze-exception for promotions that are net-neutral in headcount but we need the following completed:
1) Fill the official Freeze Exception Form (link below) with req IDs and finance codes.
2) Attach the promotion packet (manager justification + peer feedback) and the cost delta spreadsheet.
3) Confirm the proposed start dates for promotion and backfill.

Freeze Exception Form: https://peopleops.example.com/freeze-exception-form/submit
Comp approvals typically take 3 business days once the packet is uploaded. If you need an expedited review, mark the form as "Time-sensitive: Ops-impact" and include the ops sync minutes where this was raised.

Please let us know when you’ve submitted and we’ll queue it for review.

Best,
PeopleOps Team

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, peopleops-hr@peopleops.example.com
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Backfill request: IC->Lead promotion and headcount tradeoffs

Approved (conditional) —

I’ve reviewed the justification and the cost spreadsheet. Approve the backfill exception on the following conditions:
- Total incremental FY26 cost for the promotion must not exceed $10k ARR (your spreadsheet shows ~$8.2k, acceptable).
- The external QE req (REQ-PLAT-2347) is delayed and re-evaluated at the Q2 planning checkpoint; confirm in writing the contractor coverage plan duration.
- PeopleOps to process the freeze-exception form and comp packet within 72 hours of submission.
- Update the org chart (Team Pages) and compensation ledger once promotion is executed.

Marissa — please proceed with the HR submission and loop me if any of the contingencies change.

Approved by —
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product & Ops Officer
Redwood Inference
